content: UILaunchScreen (storyboard/nib/generated) is intentionally static -- no custom view code, no animation, by Apple design (must not run CPU work before app is ready). Common workaround is a pseudo-launch-screen: an in-app view visually identical to the launch screen shown first, then animated away once real content is ready. Simulator and device can render/timing differently -- must verify on a real device, especially cold/force-quit launch.
